title: 10 GW LOST AT ONCE
TAIWAN GOES DARK
yt_title: What If Hackers Blacked Out Taiwan at 9 PM? #shorts
hook: A simulation: at nine at night the grid in southern Taiwan loses ten gigawatts, and the chip factories are in trouble within the hour.

title: 11 DAYS OF GAS
IF TAIWAN GOES DARK
yt_title: What If Taiwan's Gas Terminals Stalled in a Blackout? #shorts
hook: A simulation: Taiwan holds about eleven days of gas, but with the terminals stalled it cannot burn what it cannot move.

title: NO MISSILE FIRED
TAIWAN'S CHIPS STOP
yt_title: What If Hackers Stopped Taiwan's Chip Supply? #shorts
hook: A simulation: where do the chips stop when a blackout hits Taiwan, and how could a grid fall without a single missile?
